dashboard.label: P10 - Wazuh + Splunk SIEM Integration Dashboard
dashboard.description: Unified Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR/XDR) Telemetry Pipeline: Real-time correlation and visualization of Wazuh Manager alerts, rule firings, agent activity, and MITRE ATT&CK mappings within Splunk Enterprise.

search.query: index=wazuh earliest=-30d | eval agent_val=coalesce('agent.name', host), agent_label=coalesce('agent.name', host) + " (" + coalesce('agent.id', "000") + ")" | stats count by agent_val agent_label | table agent_label agent_val

index=wazuh $agent_filter$ | eval severity_tier = case( 'rule.level' >= 12, "Critical (L12-15)", 'rule.level' >= 8 AND 'rule.level' < 12, "High (L8-11)", 'rule.level' >= 5 AND 'rule.level' < 8, "Medium (L5-7)", 'rule.level' < 5, "Low (L0-4)" ) | stats count by severity_tier

panel.title: Alert Velocity Over Time by Severity Tier (Panel 3)

search.query: index=wazuh $agent_filter$ | eval severity_tier = case( 'rule.level' >= 12, "Critical", 'rule.level' >= 8 AND 'rule.level' < 12, "High", 'rule.level' >= 5 AND 'rule.level' < 8, "Medium", 'rule.level' < 5, "Low" ) | timechart span=1h count by severity_tier
index=wazuh $agent_filter$ | eval rule_label = 'rule.id' + " - " + substr('rule.description', 1, 40) | top limit=10 rule_label

index=wazuh | eval agent_name = coalesce('agent.name', "wazuh-server") | eval agent_id = coalesce('agent.id', "000") | eval agent_ip = coalesce('agent.ip', "127.0.0.1") | stats count as total_events count(eval('rule.level'>=10)) as high_crit_alerts dc('rule.id') as unique_rules latest(_time) as last_seen by agent_id agent_name agent_ip | convert ctime(last_seen) | sort - total_events

index=wazuh $agent_filter$ ('rule.groups{}'="authentication*" OR 'rule.id'="60106" OR 'rule.id'="60122" OR 'rule.id'="5710" OR 'rule.id'="5715") | eval auth_result = case( 'rule.groups{}'="authentication_failed" OR 'rule.id'="60122" OR 'rule.id'="5710", "FAILED_AUTH", 'rule.groups{}'="authentication_success" OR 'rule.id'="60106" OR 'rule.id'="5715", "SUCCESSFUL_AUTH", true(), "OTHER_AUTH" ) | timechart span=1h count by auth_result

index=wazuh $agent_filter$ isnotnull('rule.mitre.id{}') | mvexpand 'rule.mitre.id{}' | eval mitre_tech = 'rule.mitre.id{}' | eval mitre_tactic = coalesce('rule.mitre.tactic{}', "Unassigned") | stats count as event_count values('rule.description') as associated_rules values(agent.name) as target_agents by mitre_tech mitre_tactic | sort - event_count

index=wazuh $agent_filter$ 'rule.level'>=10 | eval severity = case('rule.level'>=14, "CRITICAL", 'rule.level'>=12, "VERY HIGH", true(), "HIGH") | eval src = coalesce('data.win.eventdata.ipAddress', 'data.srcip', src_ip, "N/A") | eval target_user = coalesce('data.win.eventdata.targetUserName', 'data.srcuser', 'data.dstuser', user, "N/A") | eval endpoint = coalesce('agent.name', 'data.win.system.computer', host) | eval mitre_id = coalesce('rule.mitre.id{}', "None") | sort - _time | head 25 | table _time severity 'rule.level' 'rule.id' 'rule.description' endpoint src target_user mitre_id

index=wazuh $agent_filter$ | eval src = coalesce('data.win.eventdata.ipAddress', 'data.srcip', src_ip, "N/A") | eval user = coalesce('data.win.eventdata.targetUserName', 'data.srcuser', user, "N/A") | sort - _time | head 20 | table _time 'agent.name' 'rule.level' 'rule.id' 'rule.description' src user

(index=wazuh $agent_filter$) OR (index=windows EventCode=4625) OR (index=sysmon EventID=3) | eval telemetry_source = case( index="wazuh", "Wazuh Alert (" + 'rule.id' + ")", index="windows", "Windows Security EID " + EventCode, index="sysmon", "Sysmon EID 3 Network", true(), index ) | eval event_summary = coalesce('rule.description', Message, CommandLine, "Security Event") | eval src_ip = coalesce('data.win.eventdata.ipAddress', SourceIp, 'data.srcip', src_ip, "N/A") | eval user_account = coalesce('data.win.eventdata.targetUserName', TargetUserName, user, "N/A") | sort - _time | head 30 | table _time telemetry_source event_summary src_ip user_account host
